budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission requested $200K in ARPA funds for manhole repairs.
budget_items.quote: the commission is requesting $200k for manhole repairs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The ARPA request would repair 84 manholes at a printed total cost of $195,320, with per-location costs listed.
budget_items.quote: the repairs to these 84 manholes would cost $195,320.

budget_items.topic: Pump station component of ARPA request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The second component of the ARPA request was $300K for pump stations, with a pump station list totalling $305K.
budget_items.quote: paula noted the 2nd component of the request is for $300k for the pump stations.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The yearly budget was described as limited, allowing 8-10 manholes a year against 168 in need of repair; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: paula stated the yearly budget is limited and they have only been able to fix 8-10 per year out of the 168 in need of repair.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave asked whether ARPA funds were being taken back as part of the debt ceiling discussion; no one had information. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: dave asked if the arpa funds were being taken back as part of the debt ceiling discussion, but no one had any information.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The revised capital list (cranes, block heaters, a panel and a dialer at Meadowwoods) totals $45,237.80, which Paula said the budget would cover.
budget_items.quote: the revised list is: 3 cranes, block heaters, a panel and a dialer at meadowwoods for a total of $45,237.80.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Al Packard estimated the SKADA system for Dana and Mass 1 at $16K each.
budget_items.quote: al would like to put dana and mass 1 in the skada and estimates they will be $16k each.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The earlier fine was $25/day plus a $50 non-compliance fee; the invoice sent on 3/1/23 was $2,525, and the Commission reduced it to $750 by vote.
budget_items.quote: the commission voted to implement the fine of $25/day, plus the $50 non-compliance fee.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A fine invoice of $2,525 was sent to A&D Crossroads on 3/1/23 with no response.
budget_items.quote: sent a&d crossroads a fine invoice of $2,525.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave suggested reducing the fine to $750, with more severe fines if it happens again; the Commission agreed.
budget_items.quote: dave suggested reducing the fine to $750, with more severe fines, if it happens again.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 budget was increased for I/I work, with $28K added for jetting.

budget_items.topic: Jetting truck rental and contractor cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An estimate of $4,800 per week to rent a jetting truck was obtained; a contractor such as Clean Basins would cost $2,500-2,800/day.
budget_items.quote: bill noted he obtained an estimate of $4,800 per week to rent a jetting truck.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Question of whether DPW labor for jetting comes from the Sewer or DPW budget; Bill will look into it. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: john asked if the dpw labor would come out of the sewer or dpw budget and bill will look into it.
